interactives.label: Rules of the road
interactives.text: One party at a time on each road. Die and you wake outside; leave by a waystone and the road counts you out. The court is the end of it.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The charcoal road
interactives.text: Burners cut this road so the carts could run under the canopy in the rains. The boars found it before the carts did.

interactives.label: Reward cache
interactives.text: The run's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.

interactives.label: The court is quiet
interactives.text: Whoever reads this walked the whole road. The cache is yours; the waystone is the way home.

gauntlet.name: The Resin Road
gauntlet.flavour: The charcoal burners cut a road under the forest to move resin in the wet months. The forest moved in behind them.
